cases.reason: Miami's official Thursday report upgraded Jaylen Wright to full participation, resolving the availability condition that blocked the prior De'Von Achane case. The current official depth chart lists Wright first and Ollie Gordon II second. Estimate Achane's additional vacant duties across that active two-back group; both candidates have the same locked value, so the equal-share assumption is value-invariant while their existing duties remain preserved.
cases.reopenOn: Miami names a different primary back, changes Wright or Gordon's availability, documents unequal additional role shares, or adds another running-back absence.

replacementModel.assumptionRationale: Assume equal additional vacant-role duty for Jaylen Wright and Ollie Gordon II, the two active backs on Miami's current official depth chart. Their locked values are identical, so the effective replacement value is allocation-invariant.
replacementModel.baselineRationale: Wright and Gordon retain their existing contributions; only Achane's additional vacant duties are estimated. No existing duties are displaced or credited twice.

replacements.roleRationale: Official injury reporting upgraded Wright to full participation and the current depth chart lists him first; only additional vacant duties are estimated.
